issues.title: [SF-A00-T03] Split Studio registration seams (commands, menus, tools, automation API)
issues.body:
<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A00-T03 -->

# Split Studio registration seams (commands, menus, tools, automation API)

**Area:** A00 — Contracts and agent integration  

**Parent:** [SF-A00-E01](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/2)  

**Priority / phase:** P1 / P1 Foundations

## Audited starting point

Product source: `011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78`; later CI-only fix `7f0ca223d1b9a07725078260020019cfb276c241` is preserved, not treated as product parity.

- [packages/bytecode/src/index.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/bytecode/src/index.js)

- [packages/framework/src/index.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/framework/src/index.js)

- [apps/studio/studio.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/apps/studio/studio.js)

## Deliverable

Extract command, menu, tool-panel, automation-API and storage registries from apps/studio/studio.js; moving document and session state into services stays with SF-A19 Extract document and session services.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two independently registered tools start without global state leakage; rollback a failed registration.

- [ ] Add positive, malformed/negative, cancellation/disposal and boundary tests where applicable.

- [ ] Verify every affected execution/platform target independently; explicitly record unsupported targets.

- [ ] Add or update a runnable example, API capability row and regression test.

- [ ] Measure cold/warm latency, p95/p99 and allocations for performance-sensitive paths; keep correctness gates.

- [ ] Record exact commits, tool versions and commands; no fixture simulator is reported as native qualification.

## Atomic implementation checklist

- [ ] Pin the applicable specification/API signatures and reproduce the current gap.

- [ ] Implement the smallest owned module change; do not mix unrelated cleanup.

- [ ] Add public contract/adapter integration through the shared-file owner.

- [ ] Add edge-case and cross-engine/reference fixtures.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

- [ ] Validate rebased integration and attach the evidence before closing.

**Proposed new test prefix:** `tests/a00-03-*.test.js` (existing runner discovers top-level `.test.js`).

## Dependencies

- [SF-A00-T01](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/4)

## Ownership and parallel-agent rules

**Write only:** `planning/contracts/**`, `scripts/planning/**`

**Read-only evidence is not permission to edit shared files.** New paths above are proposed extraction destinations.

**Exclusive lease:** `area:A00`

Registry IDs, shared runtime dispatchers, root build/test registration and `studio.js` require A00 integration review. Narrow the file lock at claim time before running a second agent in this area. Never edit another area to bypass a dependency.

## Agent handoff

Agent: unassigned. Branch: not created. Lease/heartbeat: not claimed. Record task ID, branch, last verified commit, commands, artifacts, blockers and next step in each handoff. Ready means prerequisite contracts have merged and been qualified, not merely that another agent started them.

## Scope boundary

This task owns only the deliverable above. Existing behavior is extended/qualified rather than reimplemented blindly. Full parity is measured against a versioned inventory; browser platform restrictions must be explicit, not hidden behind a success label.

## Revision 2026-10-03

Scope revised after a code audit of `main`. Overlaps the A19 task Extract document and session services; A00 should only deliver the registration seams and container, not the state migration.

# Partition build and test registration

**Area:** A00 — Contracts and agent integration  

**Parent:** [SF-A00-E01](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/2)  

**Priority / phase:** P1 / P1 Foundations

## Audited starting point

Product source: `011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78`; later CI-only fix `7f0ca223d1b9a07725078260020019cfb276c241` is preserved, not treated as product parity.

- [packages/bytecode/src/index.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/bytecode/src/index.js)

- [packages/framework/src/index.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/framework/src/index.js)

- [apps/studio/studio.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/apps/studio/studio.js)

## Deliverable

Introduce per-area test manifests, task contributions, build contributions and workspace-derived package verification so package.json, scripts/build.js and scripts/verify-packages.js stop being shared edit points.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every current test is still discovered; missing or duplicate test manifests fail CI.

- [ ] Add positive, malformed/negative, cancellation/disposal and boundary tests where applicable.

- [ ] Verify every affected execution/platform target independently; explicitly record unsupported targets.

- [ ] Add or update a runnable example, API capability row and regression test.

- [ ] Measure cold/warm latency, p95/p99 and allocations for performance-sensitive paths; keep correctness gates.

- [ ] Record exact commits, tool versions and commands; no fixture simulator is reported as native qualification.

## Atomic implementation checklist

- [ ] Pin the applicable specification/API signatures and reproduce the current gap.

- [ ] Implement the smallest owned module change; do not mix unrelated cleanup.

- [ ] Add public contract/adapter integration through the shared-file owner.

- [ ] Add edge-case and cross-engine/reference fixtures.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

- [ ] Validate rebased integration and attach the evidence before closing.

**Proposed new test prefix:** `tests/a00-06-*.test.js` (existing runner discovers top-level `.test.js`).

## Dependencies

- [SF-A00-T01](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/4)

## Ownership and parallel-agent rules

**Write only:** `planning/contracts/**`, `scripts/planning/**`

**Read-only evidence is not permission to edit shared files.** New paths above are proposed extraction destinations.

**Exclusive lease:** `area:A00`

Registry IDs, shared runtime dispatchers, root build/test registration and `studio.js` require A00 integration review. Narrow the file lock at claim time before running a second agent in this area. Never edit another area to bypass a dependency.

## Agent handoff

Agent: unassigned. Branch: not created. Lease/heartbeat: not claimed. Record task ID, branch, last verified commit, commands, artifacts, blockers and next step in each handoff. Ready means prerequisite contracts have merged and been qualified, not merely that another agent started them.

## Scope boundary

This task owns only the deliverable above. Existing behavior is extended/qualified rather than reimplemented blindly. Full parity is measured against a versioned inventory; browser platform restrictions must be explicit, not hidden behind a success label.

## Revision 2026-10-03

Scope revised after a code audit of `main`. The shared edit points are three files, not only package.json: build.js hard-codes 12 stylesheets and verify-packages.js hard-codes 25 tarballs and a names array.

# Lossless syntax foundations

**Area:** A01 — CSharp syntax and language versions  

**Parent:** [SF-PORTFOLIO](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/1)  

**Priority / phase:** P1 / P1 Foundations

## Audited starting point

Product source: `011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78`; later CI-only fix `7f0ca223d1b9a07725078260020019cfb276c241` is preserved, not treated as product parity.

- [packages/syntax/src/parser.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/syntax/src/parser.js)

- [packages/syntax/src/lexer.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/syntax/src/lexer.js)

## Child work

- [SF-A01-T01](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues?q=SF-A01-T01): Build CSharp 1 through 15 syntax matrix

- [SF-A01-T02](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues?q=SF-A01-T02): Preserve trivia and malformed syntax

- [SF-A01-T03](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues?q=SF-A01-T03): Implement incremental parsing

- [SF-A01-T04](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues?q=SF-A01-T04): Complete literal and directive lexing

- [SF-A01-T05](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues?q=SF-A01-T05): Parse declaration forms

- [SF-A01-T06](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues?q=SF-A01-T06): Parse expression and pattern families

Close only after every child has merged evidence. The project board must not count an epic and its children as independent delivered capabilities.

## Dependencies

No implementation prerequisite. Claim still requires an ownership lease.

## Ownership and parallel-agent rules

**Write only:** `packages/syntax/**`

**Read-only evidence is not permission to edit shared files.** New paths above are proposed extraction destinations.

**Exclusive lease:** `area:A01`

Registry IDs, shared runtime dispatchers, root build/test registration and `studio.js` require A00 integration review. Narrow the file lock at claim time before running a second agent in this area. Never edit another area to bypass a dependency.

## Agent handoff

Agent: unassigned. Branch: not created. Lease/heartbeat: not claimed. Record task ID, branch, last verified commit, commands, artifacts, blockers and next step in each handoff. Ready means prerequisite contracts have merged and been qualified, not merely that another agent started them.

## Scope boundary

This task owns only the deliverable above. Existing behavior is extended/qualified rather than reimplemented blindly. Full parity is measured against a versioned inventory; browser platform restrictions must be explicit, not hidden behind a success label.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

## Atomic implementation checklist

- [ ] Pin the applicable specification/API signatures and reproduce the current gap.

- [ ] Implement the smallest owned module change; do not mix unrelated cleanup.

- [ ] Add public contract/adapter integration through the shared-file owner.

- [ ] Add edge-case and cross-engine/reference fixtures.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

- [ ] Validate rebased integration and attach the evidence before closing.

**Proposed new test prefix:** `tests/a01-05-*.test.js` (existing runner discovers top-level `.test.js`).

## Dependencies

- [SF-A00-T05](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/8)

## Ownership and parallel-agent rules

**Write only:** `packages/syntax/**`

**Read-only evidence is not permission to edit shared files.** New paths above are proposed extraction destinations.

**Exclusive lease:** `area:A01`

Registry IDs, shared runtime dispatchers, root build/test registration and `studio.js` require A00 integration review. Narrow the file lock at claim time before running a second agent in this area. Never edit another area to bypass a dependency.

## Agent handoff

Agent: unassigned. Branch: not created. Lease/heartbeat: not claimed. Record task ID, branch, last verified commit, commands, artifacts, blockers and next step in each handoff. Ready means prerequisite contracts have merged and been qualified, not merely that another agent started them.

## Scope boundary

This task owns only the deliverable above. Existing behavior is extended/qualified rather than reimplemented blindly. Full parity is measured against a versioned inventory; browser platform restrictions must be explicit, not hidden behind a success label.

## Revision 2026-10-03

Scope revised after a code audit of `main`. Namespaces already parse but are flattened and types are flattened to strings; only `class` with an IDisposable base list parses (SF1010/SF1014/SF1015), so the task must state the structural change, not just add forms.

issues.title: [SF-A06-B03] All non-string records are costed at 8 bytes per slot regardless of element type
issues.body:
<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A06-B03 -->

**Parent:** #86 (SF-A06-E01) · **Workstream:** A06 — JavaScript managed garbage collector · **Priority:** P1

## Defect

sizeOf (heap.js:6) uses 32+data.length*8, so byte[] and bool[] are overcharged 8x and budgets (maxBytes 32 MiB default) are exhausted at about 4M bytes of byte data; combined with the 1,000,000 element cap this blocks realistic buffers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Per-element size derives from element type; byte[1_000_000] accounts about 1 MB.

- [ ] Regression test reproduces the defect before the fix and passes after.

issues.title: [SF-A06-T13] Document current ManagedHeap behaviour as an executable specification
issues.body:
<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A06-T13 -->

**Parent:** #463 (SF-A06-E03) · **Workstream:** A06 — JavaScript managed garbage collector · **Priority:** P0

## Deliverable

Add packages/runtime/src/gc/README-spec.test.js-backed doc comments plus tests/gc-baseline.test.js pinning today's algorithm: non-moving stop-the-world mark-sweep; handle table records[] with {kind,type,data,size}; references are frozen {h,g} with a global monotonically increasing generation counter and LIFO free-slot reuse; marking uses an explicit work stack and a Uint32Array epoch mark table; sweep is a linear scan of all slots; trigger is liveBytes+request > threshold where threshold = clamp(liveBytes*2+1024, 64 KiB, maxBytes) and default maxBytes is 32 MiB; roots are rootProvider() (VM stacks, statics, constants, scheduler, platform), withRoots pins, extraRoots and strong host handles; weak host handles are cleared after sweep; sizes are estimates (string 24+2n, others 32+8n); arrays capped at 1,000,000 elements; no finalizers, generations, compaction, LOH, managed weak references or write barriers.

- [ ] Baseline tests assert each listed property (threshold formula, handle reuse order, stale-handle fault, weak clearing, size estimates) so later changes are deliberate.

issues.title: [SF-A09-B02] JsonSerializer rejects Dictionary<int,T> and silently loses numeric precision on parse
issues.body:
<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A09-B02 -->

**Parent:** #128 (SF-A09-E01) · **Workstream:** A09 — BCL IO serialization compression and crypto · **Priority:** P1

- [ ] When all contexts are waiting with no timers or host operations pending, the runtime reports a deadlock fault naming the wait chain instead of returning 'waiting'.

- [ ] Regression test reproduces the defect before the fix and passes after.

## Ownership

**Owns:** `packages/runtime/src/scheduler.js`. Workstream write scope: `packages/runtime/src/scheduler.js`, `packages/threading/**`. Shared hot files (`compiler/src/index.js`, `syntax/src/parser.js`, runtime dispatchers, `framework/src/index.js`, `studio.js`) are edited only through the A00 seams or with an explicit lock recorded in the project's **Lock keys** field.

## Claiming

Single-PR leaf. To claim: set **Agent**, **Lease expires** and **Branch** on the project item and move **Status** to *Claimed*; one agent, one branch, one focused PR. Release the lease if you stop.

<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A14-B01 -->

**Parent:** #198 (SF-A14-E01) · **Workstream:** A14 — Debugger EnC Hot Reload and DAP · **Priority:** P1

<!-- sharpforge-backlog:SF-A27-T04 -->

# Implement interpreter dispatch and frames for CIL first, source bytecode second

**Area:** A27 — Rust runtime and Wasm execution port  

**Parent:** [SF-A27-E01](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/370)  

**Priority / phase:** P1 / P1 Foundations

## Audited starting point

Product source: `011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78`; later CI-only fix `7f0ca223d1b9a07725078260020019cfb276c241` is preserved, not treated as product parity.

- [packages/runtime/src/vm.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/runtime/src/vm.js)

- [packages/runtime/src/cil-vm.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/runtime/src/cil-vm.js)

- [packages/bytecode/src/index.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/packages/bytecode/src/index.js)

## Deliverable

Port the ECMA-335 CIL instruction set (reference packages/runtime/src/cil-vm.js and packages/cil/src/opcodes.js) as the primary engine; the 30-op source bytecode (SEQ..ENUM in packages/bytecode) is a secondary compatibility engine.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Run existing non-UI fixtures differentially against both JS engines.

- [ ] Add positive, malformed/negative, cancellation/disposal and boundary tests where applicable.

- [ ] Verify every affected execution/platform target independently; explicitly record unsupported targets.

- [ ] Add or update a runnable example, API capability row and regression test.

- [ ] Measure cold/warm latency, p95/p99 and allocations for performance-sensitive paths; keep correctness gates.

- [ ] Record exact commits, tool versions and commands; no fixture simulator is reported as native qualification.

## Atomic implementation checklist

- [ ] Pin the applicable specification/API signatures and reproduce the current gap.

- [ ] Implement the smallest owned module change; do not mix unrelated cleanup.

- [ ] Add public contract/adapter integration through the shared-file owner.

- [ ] Add edge-case and cross-engine/reference fixtures.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

- [ ] Validate rebased integration and attach the evidence before closing.

**Proposed new test prefix:** `tests/a27-04-*.test.js` (existing runner discovers top-level `.test.js`).

- [SF-A00-T04](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/7)

- [SF-A00-T05](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/8)

**Write only:** `rust/runtime/**`, `rust/loader/**`, `rust/host/**`

**Read-only evidence is not permission to edit shared files.** New paths above are proposed extraction destinations.

**Exclusive lease:** `area:A27`

Registry IDs, shared runtime dispatchers, root build/test registration and `studio.js` require A00 integration review. Narrow the file lock at claim time before running a second agent in this area. Never edit another area to bypass a dependency.

## Agent handoff

Agent: unassigned. Branch: not created. Lease/heartbeat: not claimed. Record task ID, branch, last verified commit, commands, artifacts, blockers and next step in each handoff. Ready means prerequisite contracts have merged and been qualified, not merely that another agent started them.

## Scope boundary

This task owns only the deliverable above. Existing behavior is extended/qualified rather than reimplemented blindly. Full parity is measured against a versioned inventory; browser platform restrictions must be explicit, not hidden behind a success label.

## Revision 2026-10-03

Scope revised after a code audit of `main`. Two JS engines exist with very different instruction sets; the task must say which is the parity target.

- [ ] Record exact commits, tool versions and commands; no fixture simulator is reported as native qualification.

- [ ] Implement the smallest owned module change; do not mix unrelated cleanup.

- [ ] Add public contract/adapter integration through the shared-file owner.

- [ ] Add edge-case and cross-engine/reference fixtures.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

- [ ] Validate rebased integration and attach the evidence before closing.

**Proposed new test prefix:** `tests/a27-06-*.test.js` (existing runner discovers top-level `.test.js`).

# Implement cross-engine differential runner

**Area:** A29 — Conformance CI security and release engineering

**Priority / phase:** P1 / P1 Foundations

## Audited starting point

- [tests/requirements.txt](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/tests/requirements.txt)

- [tests/templates-archive.test.js](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/blob/011f2bc3bdd84f8db82a928d117100017211ca78/tests/templates-archive.test.js)

## Deliverable

Execute the same corpus in JS source, CIL and native CLR now, with Rust native and Wasm adapters reporting unsupported until A27 ships artifacts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Classify compiler/runtime/host differences with minimal repros and deterministic seeds.

- [ ] Add positive, malformed/negative, cancellation/disposal and boundary tests where applicable.

- [ ] Verify every affected execution/platform target independently; explicitly record unsupported targets.

- [ ] Add or update a runnable example, API capability row and regression test.

- [ ] Measure cold/warm latency, p95/p99 and allocations for performance-sensitive paths; keep correctness gates.

- [ ] Record exact commits, tool versions and commands; no fixture simulator is reported as native qualification.

## Atomic implementation checklist

- [ ] Pin the applicable specification/API signatures and reproduce the current gap.

- [ ] Implement the smallest owned module change; do not mix unrelated cleanup.

- [ ] Add public contract/adapter integration through the shared-file owner.

- [ ] Add edge-case and cross-engine/reference fixtures.

- [ ] Update examples and compatibility inventory, then submit a focused PR.

- [ ] Validate rebased integration and attach the evidence before closing.

**Proposed new test prefix:** `tests/a29-04-*.test.js` (existing runner discovers top-level `.test.js`).

## Dependencies

No implementation prerequisite. Claim still requires an ownership lease.

**Write only:** `.github/workflows/**`, `tests/conformance/**`, `scripts/conformance/**`, `planning/qualification/**`

Scope revised after a code audit of `main`. No rust/ directory exists yet; the task must be deliverable before the Rust port.

# Enforce fair numeric-worker and memory budgets across concurrent app sessions

Release: [0.15 delivery](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/422). Area: **A10**. Parent: [SF-A10-T08](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/issues/151).
